fixed: A shorthand for one of your own figures or for a combination now still works when you give it a beat count (`16 zm` or `zm (16)`), in the free-text box and in a row's Move box. Before, it was added as a plain custom figure. Your own figure takes the count as its beats; a combination is added as saved and the count is ignored.

added: `splitShorthandCount` splits a leading or trailing beat count off a line, for callers that match shorthands of their own kind (#1861).
